info.title: Kronos Crypto Data API
info.description: Kronos pay-per-call real-time crypto market-data API for autonomous agents and trading bots. Pay-per-call endpoints across 17 crypto assets (HYPE derivatives-only). (1) /api/v1/signals/{asset} — perpetual futures derivatives (funding, OI, basis) for 17 assets ($0.02); (2) /api/v1/price/{asset} — multi-source spot price for 16 assets ($0.02); (3) /api/v1/snapshot/{asset} — full bundle: price + derivatives + regime ($0.08); (4) /api/v1/overview — market-wide derivatives snapshot for all 17 assets ($0.02); (5) /api/v1/alerts/btc — market-regime alerts ($0.02); (6) /api/v1/funding-extremes — all 17 assets ranked by absolute funding rate ($0.02); (7) /api/v1/fear-greed — Crypto Fear & Greed Index from alternative.me ($0.03); (8) /api/v1/ohlc/{asset} — OHLC candlestick data from Binance ($0.02); (9) /api/v1/volatility/{asset} — 7d/30d realized volatility ($0.02). Premium add-on: /api/v1/forecast/{asset} — ML price-direction forecasts for BTC/ETH/SOL ($0.05). All paid via x402 USDC micropayments on Base mainnet (eip155:8453). Public: /api/stats, /api/health.
info.x-disclaimer: All output is informational only and NOT financial advice. Forecasts are probabilistic model outputs; signals are heuristics derived from public market data. Past signals do not guarantee future returns. Use at your own risk.

get.summary: Crypto directional forecast (BTC / ETH / SOL)
get.description: Returns a directional price forecast for the requested asset computed from live Binance OHLCV data. The primary model is Kronos-small (ML); if unavailable the fallback is a composite EMA(20/50)/RSI(14)/MACD(12,26,9)/ATR(14) vote-based heuristic. Requires an x402 EIP-3009 micropayment of $0.05 USDC. On the first call (no X-PAYMENT header) the server returns HTTP 402 with payment instructions; re-send with the X-PAYMENT header populated by an x402 client library.

parameters.name: asset
parameters.description: Asset to forecast. BTC-USD is the default and most reliable. ETH-USD and SOL-USD use the same model pipeline. Assets map to Binance symbols BTCUSDT / ETHUSDT / SOLUSDT.

parameters.name: horizon
parameters.description: Forecast horizon: 1h uses 1-hour candles, 4h uses 4-hour candles, 24h uses daily candles. Defaults to 1h.

example.disclaimer: Probabilistic forecast from the Kronos-small model. Not financial advice. Past signals do not guarantee future returns.

asset.description: Normalized asset identifier (e.g. BTC-USD, ETH-USD, SOL-USD).

timeframe.description: Binance candle interval used (1d = daily, maps to 24h horizon). Present in composite-fallback responses only.

generated_at.description: UTC timestamp when this forecast was computed.

atr.description: ATR(14) in USD — used to compute range_low/range_high.

indicators.description: Raw technical indicator values. Present in composite-fallback responses only (null in Kronos-small responses).

signal.description: Per-indicator votes. Present in composite-fallback responses only.

votes.description: 6-element array: +1 bullish, -1 bearish, 0 neutral. Order: [close>EMA20, close>EMA50, EMA20>EMA50, RSI, MACD, MACDhist].

up_prob.description: Probability of upward price movement over the horizon (0.0–1.0). In the composite fallback: fraction of bullish indicator votes.

range_low.description: Estimated lower bound of the price range: close − 1.5×ATR(14).

range_high.description: Estimated upper bound of the price range: close + 1.5×ATR(14).

horizon_bars.description: Number of candles the horizon spans (e.g. 20).

confidence.description: Indicator agreement score: max(positives, negatives) / total_votes in the composite fallback; model-specific confidence in Kronos-small.

mean_path_closes.description: Optional mean simulated price path from Kronos-small ML model. Array of close prices at each horizon bar. Only present when the ML service returns it.

expected_close.description: Median predicted close for the next bar from the Kronos ML model. null on composite fallback (no ML-projected close available).

pred_high.description: P90 predicted bar high — upper extreme of the predicted price range. On composite fallback: approximated as range_high (close + 1.5×ATR).

pred_low.description: P10 predicted bar low — lower extreme of the predicted price range. On composite fallback: approximated as range_low (close − 1.5×ATR).

pred_volatility.description: Forward 1-bar volatility as a fraction of price (e.g. 0.008 = 0.8%). On composite fallback: approximated as ATR(14)/close.

prob_up.description: P(close > current price) from the Kronos ML model. On composite fallback: same as up_prob (fraction of bullish indicator votes).

quantiles.description: Distribution of predicted close prices from the Kronos ML model. null on composite fallback (no distribution available).

risk_state.description: Volatility flag from composite fallback: 'elevated' when ATR/close > 2%. Not present in Kronos-small responses.

directional_context.description: Human-readable direction context from composite fallback only.

model.description: Model identifier used. 'Kronos-small' for the ML path; 'kronos-signal-composite-v1 (fallback)' for the EMA/RSI/MACD/ATR path.

inference_seconds.description: Wall-clock inference time in seconds from the Kronos ML service. Only present when the ML path was used.

disclaimer.description: Mandatory disclaimer. Not financial advice. Heuristic or probabilistic output only.

402.description: Payment required — x402 micropayment instructions. The response body and X-PAYMENT-REQUIRED header contain the payment requirements in x402 format. Submit 0.05 USDC on Base mainnet (eip155:8453) using an x402 client, then retry with the X-PAYMENT header.

X-PAYMENT-REQUIRED.description: Base64-encoded JSON payment requirements (amount, asset, network, payTo, scheme).

get.summary: Crypto derivatives intelligence for 17 assets (funding rate, OI, basis)
get.description: Returns perpetual swap market intelligence for any of the 16 supported assets (BTC/ETH/SOL/BNB/XRP/DOGE/ADA/AVAX/LINK/DOT/LTC/TRX/BCH/ATOM/NEAR/APT) sourced from OKX. Raw fields: funding rate (raw 8-hour + heuristic annualised), mark price, index price, basis (perp premium/discount), open interest, 24h volume, next funding time. Derived signals: OI change over ~1 hour window (abs + pct), funding trend (rising/falling/flat vs prior half-window), and a human-readable heuristic read. Data is collected every 5 minutes by a background cron into the market_signals table; responses may lag by up to 5 minutes. Requires an x402 EIP-3009 micropayment of $0.02 USDC.

parameters.name: asset
parameters.description: Asset slug (lowercase). Supports all 17 assets (incl. hype).

example.read: Positive funding (10.9% ann.) — longs paying shorts; carry favours short-basis trades. Heuristic only.
example.disclaimer: Heuristic signal derived from OKX perpetual swap data. Not financial advice. Data lags by up to 5 minutes (cron cadence). Annualized rates assume the current funding rate persists indefinitely — it does not.

as_of.description: Timestamp of the most recent market_signals row (UTC). Reflects when the cron last collected data.

data_source.description: Exchange that provided the raw data (e.g. 'bybit', 'okx').

samples.description: Number of market_signals rows used (up to 12, ~1 h of data at 5-min cadence).

funding_rate.description: Raw 8-hour funding rate from the latest row. Positive = longs pay shorts; negative = shorts pay longs. Example: 0.0001 = 0.01% per 8 h.

funding_rate_annualized.description: Heuristic annualised rate: funding_rate × 3 (settlements/day) × 365. Assumes the current rate persists — it does not. Heuristic only.

mark_price.description: Perpetual swap mark price in USD.

basis.description: (mark_price − index_price) / index_price. Positive = perpetual trading at a premium to spot (contango).

open_interest.description: Open interest in the exchange's native unit (typically BTC or contracts) from the latest row.

next_funding_time.description: UTC timestamp of the next funding settlement.

oi_change_1h.description: Open interest change over the sample window (~1 h). Computed as latest OI minus oldest OI in the window.

abs.description: Absolute OI change (same units as open_interest). Positive = OI growing; negative = OI shrinking.

pct.description: OI percentage change over the window.

funding_trend.description: Heuristic funding rate trend: compares recent half-window average vs older half-window average with a ±5% relative threshold. 'insufficient_data' when fewer than 4 rows have funding data.

read.description: Human-readable heuristic interpretation of the current derivatives market state. Not financial advice.
read.example: Positive funding (10.9% ann.) — longs paying shorts; carry favours short-basis trades. Heuristic only.

disclaimer.description: Mandatory disclaimer. Heuristic signal only; not financial advice.

get.summary: BTC market-state alerts (regime events + live derived state)
get.description: Returns the CURRENT actionable market-state for BTC that an agent can poll: recent regime events detected by the Kronos regime engine within the last ~2 hours (squeeze, breakout, funding_extreme, oi_surge) plus live derived state from the latest market_signals row (funding rate, heuristic annualised funding, open interest, and a short plain-language read). Regime events are detected on a ~15-minute cron; live state may lag by up to 5 minutes. Requires an x402 EIP-3009 micropayment of $0.02 USDC.

get.summary: Real-time crypto spot price (16 assets) — $0.02/call
get.description: Returns the current spot price for any of the 16 supported assets from the Binance public API. Multi-source reference price — $0.02 USDC per call. Supports BTC/ETH/SOL/BNB/XRP/DOGE/ADA/AVAX/LINK/DOT/LTC/TRX/BCH/ATOM/NEAR/APT. Optional ?coins=BTC,ETH,SOL batches up to 10 additional symbols (case-insensitive, de-duped) in the same paid call; adds quotes[] and unresolved[] to the response. Single-asset response is unchanged when coins= is absent. Requires an x402 EIP-3009 micropayment of $0.02 USDC.

parameters.description: Asset slug (lowercase). All 16 assets supported.

parameters.name: coins
parameters.description: Optional comma-separated symbol list (e.g. BTC,ETH,SOL) to batch up to 10 additional quotes in one paid call. Case-insensitive; de-duped; unresolved symbols are listed in unresolved[], never fabricated.

example.disclaimer: Real-time spot price from Binance public API. Informational only, not financial advice.

quotes.description: Present only when ?coins= is used. One entry per resolved symbol, same shape as the top-level price fields.

unresolved.description: Present only when ?coins= is used. Symbols from coins= that could not be resolved to a supported asset.

get.summary: Full crypto asset snapshot bundle (16 assets) — $0.08/call
get.description: Returns everything for the asset in one call: spot price, derivatives (funding rate, OI, basis, trend), market regime alerts (BTC only), the Kronos ML forecast for the 1h horizon (BTC/ETH/SOL only), options IV summary from Deribit (BTC/ETH only; available:false otherwise), liquidation squeeze_bias derived from funding rate + OI split, and Coinbase CEX premium (Coinbase-listed assets only; available:false otherwise). Supports all 16 assets (BTC/ETH/SOL/BNB/XRP/DOGE/ADA/AVAX/LINK/DOT/LTC/TRX/BCH/ATOM/NEAR/APT). Cheaper than buying each tool separately. Requires an x402 EIP-3009 micropayment of $0.08 USDC.

get.summary: Track-record methodology (public, no payment required)
get.description: Documents how Kronos forecasts are scored and returns the CURRENT live accuracy figures pulled directly from the database. Explains what is measured (directional hit-rate of cache-served forecasts), how outcomes are scored (evaluate cron vs realized Binance candle), and the honest caveats (thin sample, one-regime data, not financial advice). Links to /api/stats for full statistics.

get.summary: Forecast accuracy track record (public, free, no payment required)
get.description: Returns a verifiable accuracy summary so an agent can audit the model's track record before paying for the full forecast ledger. Data comes from the same Supabase join (forecasts + outcomes!inner) used by the paid /api/v1/forecast-ledger. Hit rate uses cache-source rows only, matching /api/stats methodology. Includes: overall hit_rate, total resolved forecasts (n), per-asset breakdown (BTC/ETH/SOL), Brier score from the audit sample, and the last 20 resolved forecasts as row-level audit data. Full paginated history with asset/horizon/date filtering is available via /api/v1/forecast-ledger ($0.02/call via x402). 5-minute public cache (track record changes slowly as resolutions accumulate).

hit_rate.description: Fraction of cache-source resolved forecasts where predicted direction was correct. Null if no resolved forecasts yet.

total_resolved.description: Total cache-source resolved forecasts in the database.

evaluation_window.description: Description of the data window used for hit_rate.
evaluation_window.example: all time — cache-source rows only, matching /api/stats methodology

sample_note.description: Human-readable note about sample size reliability.

per_asset.description: Per-asset breakdown for BTC, ETH, SOL.

brier_score.description: Brier score from audit sample. Lower is better (0 = perfect, 0.25 = coin-flip).

brier_note.description: Human-readable note on Brier score computation.

audit_rows.description: Last 20 resolved cache-source forecasts for row-level verification.

get.summary: Cross-venue funding arbitrage signal — up to 6 exchanges, net-of-fees — $0.02/call
get.description: Queries up to 6 perpetual swap exchanges for real-time 8h-equivalent funding rates (Binance USDT-M, OKX, Bybit, KuCoin Futures, Bitget, Hyperliquid) and computes the gross and net-of-fees spread between the best short venue (highest rate8h) and the best long venue (lowest rate8h). gross_spread_bps = (best_short_rate8h − best_long_rate8h) × 10000. net_spread_bps = gross_spread_bps − 20 (ROUND_TRIP_FEE_BPS: 5 bps/side taker × 4 fills). annualized_pct = (net per-8h fraction) × 3 × 365 × 100. Actionability: not_actionable (net≤0), marginal (0<net≤5 bps), actionable (net>5 bps). Returns honest nulls when a venue fails — never fabricated. All 17 assets. $0.02 USDC via x402.
